title: Clap Clap
blurb: Two claps. Not three, not a round of applause — two, spaced far enough apart that the silence between them does the talking. This is the most passive-aggressive noise a human body can produce, and it is commentary rather than celebration: recognition offered at the exact minimum level required to avoid accusations of rudeness. Use it for sarcastic congratulation, as the opening of a slow clap that everyone can tell is not going anywhere good, or to acknowledge an achievement with visible reluctance. Well done. Truly. Genuinely, well done.
